blk_part_05_part_5_worlds_that_fool_us.text: Now think back to Turing's Imitation Game from Part 1. It asks the same question: can humans tell the difference between the real thing and an imitation? This is exactly where modern chatbots are strong, because they generate human-like text by predicting likely phrases. A chatbot cannot build a world to trap us. But it can produce human-like text so well that people may forget they are talking to a machine.
